question: The Great Stupa of Sanchi was built during the reign of which of the following kings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashoka.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Great Stupa of Sanchi** is a **Buddhist monument** located in** Sanchi, Madhya Pradesh, India.**
 
• It was originally commissioned by **Emperor Ashoka** in the **3rd century BCE **and later expanded upon by other rulers.
 
• The stupa is considered one of the oldest stone structures in India and is a** UNESCO World Heritage Site.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandragupta **was a **Mauryan emperor **who ruled before Ashoka.
 
• **Bindusara** was **Ashoka's father.**
 
• **Brihadratha **was the** last Mauryan emperor** and ruled after Ashoka.
